test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The ratio of the present age of A and B is 3 : 1. Five years ago, the ratio of their ages was 5 : 1. The age of A (in years) after eight years will be:
solution:
**Given:**

The present age ratio of A and B = 3 : 1

Five years ago, their age ratio = 5 : 1

Calculation:

Let the present ages of A and B be 3x and x respectively.

Five years ago, their ages were (3x - 5) and (x - 5).

(3x - 5)/(x - 5) = (5)/(1)

⇒ 3x - 5 = 5(x - 5)

⇒ 3x - 5 = 5x - 25

⇒ 3x - 5x = -25 + 5

⇒ -2x = -20

⇒ x = 10

Present age of A = 3x = 3 × 10 = 30 years

Age of A after 8 years = 30 + 8 = 38 years

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
